instructions: TEMPLATE ONLY - contains NO ground-truth pitches for this song. To annotate: listen to the clip (0.25x-0.5x for boundaries), fill the 'annotation' array with one {start, end, midi} event per sung note in time order, then save the array alone as saathiyaa.json (same basename, no .template suffix). See evaluation/annotations/README.md. Validate with: python evaluation/annotations/validate.py <song>.json. Gate with: python evaluation/gate_v2.py <song>.json <extracted_melody>.json

event_schema.start: note onset in seconds (perceptual pitch start, not consonant burst)
event_schema.end: note offset in seconds (stable note end or rest start); must be > start

rules: events MUST be in strictly non-overlapping time order (each start >= previous end)
same-pitch repeated syllables are TWO events with separate starts, never one merged event
a glide is ONE event with an ornament note unless the target pitch is held as a new stable note
uncertain boundaries: annotate best guess and add annotator_note + confidence downstream, do not silently force
